# Invariant — Governed delivery only (P0, Plan 1)

Load-bearing. If a change appears to require breaking this, stop and surface it to
the user rather than working around it.

**Governed delivery only — no delivered answer is generated by the wrapped/upstream
client (Plan 1).** Every user-visible answer is the text produced inside the MoralStack
governed pipeline (validated speculative draft, compliance regeneration, policy
generate/rewrite, or a governed refusal). The wrapped SDK client / proxy upstream client
is never called to generate the delivered answer for any `final_action`
(NORMAL_COMPLETE, SAFE_COMPLETE, or REFUSE), and a pipeline failure fails closed to a
governed refusal (no passthrough). The pure finalizer is
`moralstack/orchestration/delivery.py` (`finalize_delivery`); proxy `stream=True` replays
the governed text as OpenAI-compatible synthetic SSE and never forwards live upstream
tokens. Internal MoralStack LLM calls — risk mini-estimators, speculative draft, policy
generate/rewrite, and refusal wording generation — are the allowed generation sources.
The governed answer model is selected by `GovernanceConfig.model` / `OPENAI_MODEL` (and
`MORALSTACK_POLICY_REWRITE_MODEL` for revisions); the chat request `model=` is a
requested alias only.
